CanonicalVars.issue: Closed 2026-07-30 (tier-2 campaign): (Task 24.) All 23 cards now store their printed C# var under a `_`-attribute (or, for 3 cards whose C# var is a live/computed value at display time -- guilty, normality, expect_a_fight -- a `magic_number` property override; wither similarly overrides `base_damage`) so `Card.base_damage`/`base_block`/`base_hp_loss`/`magic_number` report the C# value instead of the 0/None default. Two additive base.py changes: `_frail` added to `_MAGIC_ATTRS` (shame) and a new `base_gold` property (debt, spoils_map -- GoldVar had no base property at all). feel_no_pain's `_block` was renamed to `_power_amount` (fixing a WRONG value, not just a missing one -- `base_block` no longer misreports it as block-granting; matches Rage/Corruption/Stampede's DynamicVar('Power', ...) convention). Combat behavior / dealt numbers are byte-identical in every case -- a printed-number / observation-encoder fix only. 3 of the 23 (debt, spoils_map, rolling_boulder's secondary IncrementAmount) have NO obs-vector change despite the API fix (full_env.py has no base_gold read site; magic_number carries one number per card and _power_amount dominates rolling_boulder's scan) -- documented, not closed further. CHECKPOINT NOTE for training: encoded VALUES changed for the other 20 cards in feature slots f[17]/f[18] damage, f[20]/f[21] block, f[22] hp_loss, f[23] magic_number; obs LAYOUT unchanged. Pins: test/test_printed_vars.py (48 tests).  The text it replaced read: Four vars in C#: `EnergyVar(0)`, `CalculationBaseVar(0m)`, `CalculationExtraVar(1m)` and `CalculatedVar("CalculatedEnergy").WithMultiplier(card => Hand.Cards.Count(c => c.Type == Attack))` (ExpectAFight.cs:18-24). The FORMULA is reproduced exactly -- `CalculatedVar.Calculate` is `base + extra * multiplier` (CalculatedVar.cs:62-71) = `0 + 1 * attacks` == the sim's `sum(1 for c in ctx.player.hand if c.card_type == CardType.ATTACK)` -- but none of the four vars is stored, so `magic_number` returns None and the observation encoder sees no secondary number. The card also defines no `calc_damage`-style accessor, so nothing outside `on_play` can preview the energy. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/bad_luck's CanonicalVars entry (rule 3): a printed DynamicVar with no `_`-attribute in `_init_vars`, so the sim's printed-number API reports the default and `full_env.card_features` (full_env.py:455-489) encodes the card wrongly for the policy. DORMANT for game fidelity (the applied number is identical), LIVE for the observation encoder.

OnPlay.rationale: Order matches: gain the computed energy FIRST (`PlayerCmd.GainEnergy(((CalculatedVar)DynamicVars["CalculatedEnergy"]).Calculate(cardPlay.Target), Owner)`, ExpectAFight.cs:36) == `EnergyCmd.gain(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, attacks)`, then `PowerCmd.Apply<NoEnergyGainPower>(..., 1m, ...)` (37) == `PowerCmd.apply(..., NoEnergyGainPower, 1, applier=ctx.player)`. The order is load-bearing -- NoEnergyGainPower is applied AFTER the gain, so this card's own energy is not blocked by it -- and is preserved. The Attack count is read from the hand at play time, and Expect A Fight itself is out of the hand on both sides (Play pile in C#, discard-pile limbo in the sim), so it never counts itself -- and it is a Skill anyway. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (35) and the energy hover tip (26).

OnUpgrade.rationale: `EnergyCost.UpgradeBy(-1)` (ExpectAFight.cs:42) == `self._energy_cost = max(0, self._energy_cost - 1)` (2 -> 1). The energy-per-Attack multiplier is unchanged by the upgrade on both sides.

guards.what: the sim skips the gain entirely when there are no Attacks in hand (`if attacks > 0`, expect_a_fight.py:38-39); C# calls GainEnergy(0)
guards.issue: `PlayerCmd.GainEnergy(0, ...)` (ExpectAFight.cs:36) adds nothing but still runs the engine's gain path; the sim skips the call outright (`if attacks > 0`, expect_a_fight.py:38-39), so `hooks.modify_energy_gain` (cmds.py:553) never sees the zero amount. A modifier could in principle turn 0 into something. DORMANT: no ported `modify_energy_gain` listener adds a flat bonus on a zero gain -- they all scale the incoming amount or gate on a positive one -- so the two agree today. TRIGGER: any ported `modify_energy_gain` listener that returns a flat bonus independent of the incoming amount. This is the energy-side twin of `creature_card_cmds/N5` + `/step31` (`EnergyCmd.gain` lacks C#'s `finalAmount > 0` guard), recorded here because it is Expect A Fight's own code adding the guard, not the machinery's. Recorded as a gap rather than faithful because "no ported listener does this" is a dormancy argument, not an equivalence.
